cases.prompt: Implement API tests from this approved OpenAPI operation, including success, validation and authentication cases.
expectations: Uses Playwright API facilities and existing API client/fixtures.
Asserts contract fields/statuses grounded in OpenAPI; includes negative/auth cases.
Handles test data isolation and avoids secrets in source/report.

cases.prompt: Add regression coverage for an idempotent POST /payments operation where the contract specifies the idempotency key behaviour.
expectations: Tests repeated requests using same key and verifies contract-defined side effects.
Avoids guessing status codes or response details not specified.
Separates API test logic from browser abstractions.

cases.prompt: Improve API assertions to verify persisted order state rather than only HTTP 201.
expectations: Uses authoritative persistence/observable contract as oracle.
Asserts meaningful business outcome and handles cleanup safely.
Does not introduce duplicate HTTP client or unsupported schema assumptions.

cases.prompt: Automate the user journey for creating an order through the browser UI.
expectations: Selects add-web-test when browser behaviour is the target.

cases.prompt: The API response is undocumented. Guess the expected error status and schema for invalid input.
expectations: Does not invent contract; asks for authoritative contract/clarification and blocks unsupported assertions.

cases.prompt: OpenAPI defines POST /accounts with 201, response `{id,status}`, 400 for invalid email and 409 for duplicate email. Create an API test design/implementation. The available environment URL is production and no safe test tenant is configured.
expectations: Identifies that tests would create accounts and refuses to execute/mutate production without explicit authorisation.
Uses only contract-defined status codes and response fields.
States that implementation may be prepared but execution is BLOCKED pending safe environment/test data.
Does not log credentials or real personal data.
Explains safe prerequisites and reports no fabricated run results.
